competences.description: Decreases the current HP of the enemy with the best HP status (Boss excluded) by 10%, and attacks the enemy target to inflict damage that's proportionate to the reduced HP.
Consumes half of your current HP to attack the enemy target. This attack will ignore a portion of the enemy's Defense as your HP status worsens.

effets.description: Deals damage to the monster using the skill.
Attack will ignore the target's defense.

competences.description: When an enemy is defeated by your attack, revives one ally with HP equal to the damage dealt to the target. If an ally dies while you are dead, you will be revived with little HP, the cooldown of [Madness Judgement] will be reset, and your Attack Bar will be filled up. [Automatic Effect]

effets.description: Reduces cool down counter of skills by 1 or more
effets.note: the cooldown of [Madness Judgement] will be reset

effets.description: The ATK bar of ally monsters is filled by a set amount. This allows ally monsters to attack again sooner.
